reviews.title: Good Quality Budget Mouse Pad
reviews.comment: I bought this mouse pad in August of 2018. I have used it almost daily for over seven years, through thousands of hours of gaming and normal office use. In looking at what "Customers say" and at the negative reviews, I can report that I have had zero issues with it peeling, fraying, or smelling. Someone said that it remained curled from shipping, but mine has laid flat from day one. Another person said that the edges were sharp. It does not have stitched edging but it has also never caught on my arm or sleeve, at least not to the point to where I would notice. I see where others have attacked the thickness of it, but unless you have a preference for a thick mousepad then you should not have any problems. The only drawback that I've experienced is that it does tend to slip a little during intense gaming, even with the rubber backing. It's not a major thing, but it is noticeable when you're trying to concentrate and you have to keep repositioning your mouse because it's about to come off the edge of the pad. I solved the issue by using a couple of little adhesive rug pads that I had leftover from a trip to the hardware store. Overall, the mouse pad is of good quality. I've purchased more expensive name-brand products that haven't lasted nearly as long as this one, so this is great if you're looking for a budget friendly option.
reviews.author: Jon
